fact: The Lesotho News Agency reports the CAFI Entrepreneurship Hub launched its fifth cycle incubation programme with 60 enterprises selected, in priority sectors including digital innovation.

The World Bank says the CAFI Entrepreneurship Hub runs a six-month incubation period with mentoring and grants for selected enterprises, in five cohorts to date, and has supported 464 SMEs since 2022.
The Lesotho Times reports 54 enterprises took part in the CAFI six-month incubation programme this year, and the top 15 pitched to investors at its Demo Day.
